channel.title: Anas Balghaith — Articles
channel.description: Plain-language science writing on materials science and life in the lab, for anyone interested in science.

item.title: How cooking taught me lab skills
item.description: Chopsticks, garlic sauce and espresso: hidden lessons in precision and observation I learned in the kitchen before the lab.

item.title: How do chemistry and physics meet in understanding solids?
item.description: Why did my two supervisors read the same results in opposite ways? And how the chemist Roald Hoffmann brought the chemist's and the physicist's languages together.

item.title: Why did I choose scientific research?
item.description: A personal story about a physics teacher, a burned-out lamp, and an electron I'm still chasing today.
